item.title: Incarico post-doc: Balancing Exploration and Exploitation in Artificial Agents (IULM - MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-28 23:59
Institution: IULM - MILANO, Milano
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/INFO-01 Informatica

The research aims at developing novel learning methods to train artificial neural networks to mixing gradient-based learning and neuroevolution. The problem domain are reinforcement learning scenarios characterized by agents interacting with the surrounding environment. The ideal candidate will have an interdisciplinary profile with strong background in neural networks and cognitive sciences. Required skills are the capacity of producing scientific output published in reputed international journal and conferences. The applicant is required to have fluency with python and with the packages such as numpy, pytorch, gymnasium. Previous experience in participating in competitive grants as a PI,…

item.title: Incarico post-doc: AI Literacy in University Mathematics Education - 2026_IPD_DMAT_1 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2027-01-07 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/MATH-01 Logica matematica, didattica e storia della matematica

The research will focus on AI literacy competencies in university mathematics, with particular attention to the use of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) to support mathematical reasoning, also in relation to first-year students' learning difficulties and study strategies. Building on the theoretical framework of Discipline-Specific AI Literacy (DiSAIL), the research aims to characterize the competencies required for the informed and critical use of GenAI, including recognizing when to rely on AI, formulating mathematically meaningful queries, and verifying and critically evaluating AI-generated responses, with attention to mathematical understanding, argumentation, metacognition,…

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Analysis and Observability of Partial Differential Equations (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Rome
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/MATH-03 Analisi matematica, probabilità e statistica matematica

Il progetto è dedicato all’analisi e all'osservabilità di Equazioni alle Derivate Parziali (PDE) di interesse geometrico, fisico e applicativo. L’obiettivo principale è indagare come geometrie irregolari, non linearità e strutture singolari o degeneri influenzino il comportamentoqualitativo e l’osservabilità delle soluzioni, con particolare attenzione all' interazione tra le proprietà analitiche delle PDE e la geometria sottostante, incluse reti discrete e casuali, nonché al ruolo dei termini singolari e di ordine inferiore. La ricerca riguarderà problemi ellittici e di evoluzione non lineari, tra cui soluzioni singolari di equazioni ellittiche non lineari, il p-Laplaciano (p=1) e problemi…
